caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally placed, hexagonal object with ornate surface details. It is rendered in shades of gray, suggesting a pencil or graphite medium on a plain, light background. The object has a flat back with a hexagon shape and a small circular hole at its top center, possibly for hanging. The front surface features three vertical, rectangular panels with geometric and floral patterns, each separated by thin borders. The bottom of the object projects outward in a trapezoidal form, and the overall surface, including the frame, is decorated with intricate designs, such as interlacing lines, lattice patterns, and a raised border that echoes the hexagonal outline. The artist's signature, "Amelia Ricci," appears in small text in the lower left corner of the page.
title: Match Safe
